deep_analysis.text: Cross-asset signals lean risk-on with equities firmer, VIX falling sharply, and gold edging higher, though DXY softness alongside rising US10Y yields muddies the read rather than confirming a clean dollar-down move. Bitcoin's flat performance offers little conviction either way. Headlines still frame a hawkish Fed narrative supporting the dollar broadly, creating tension with today's softer DXY tape. WTI's drop weighs on commodity-linked currencies. With US CPI due shortly alongside ECB, BoE, BoC and RBNZ decisions all landing within the next day, volatility risk is elevated and the backdrop remains genuinely mixed rather than trending.
